en: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.
We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.
Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.

Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?
Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!
{PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.
An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.
